red.reason: The new positional/config provenance cases initially reported unknown origins and no materialized config fields.

cases.positionalArg: task-variable with exact promptIndex and intact argv token
cases.inputFlag: task-variable bound to --input without splitting a spaced Chinese path
cases.configField: task-variable fields materialized only from evidence-bound config contents
cases.sourceFixed: source-fixed literal rule retained for a business constant
cases.optionalMissing: declared optional field retained as present=false and origin=unknown
cases.oldPathNegative: prompt-only old path is not introduced as an observed parameter
cases.globalReplacementNegative: operation context remains observational and prompt contract forbids global string replacement
cases.environment: environment names can be indexed while values remain redacted

implementation: OperationParameter now records presence, binding, provenance origin, source/origin locator, prompt offsets, config path/field and redaction state.
Command parsing indexes positional args, flags, path candidates, evidence-bound JSON config fields and environment names without reading the host filesystem.
Explicit source/task rules take precedence; conservative literal source inference never promotes common input/output names or dynamic values.
Workspace passes source text into the operation index and optimizer instructions require exact binding instead of global replacement.
claimBoundary: Observed or task-matched values are candidate bindings, not a proved input range. Source-fixed inference is conservative; unknown and missing values remain residual. No source file was rewritten by the index, no model/remote/paid project call occurred, and no held-out/Q1/prospective input or readiness claim was introduced.
